13/G.goal: Explain how VR hardware participates in a VR system that includes the user/organism and physical environment, and identify the main hardware categories and input devices that support user interaction.
13/G.achieves: Provides the foundational VR hardware knowledge needed for the course's aim of understanding and implementing XR systems with confidence.

13/O1.goal: Explain the systems-level view of a VR system, in which the user/organism, physical environment, and VR hardware are connected by stimulation and tracking data flows that capture user actions.
13/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a foundational model of how VR systems interact with people and surroundings, which supports later study of tracking, input, and XR system development.

13/O2.goal: Characterize the main categories of VR hardware and the hand-based and non-hand-based input devices used to capture user actions, including their capabilities, limitations, and multimodal implications.
13/O2.achieves: Enables the learner to identify and discuss VR hardware components and input options when understanding or contributing to the development of an XR system.
